title: a new export nobody uses
how: each new exported declaration of a touched file under roots that its own file does not use: referenced by whole word nowhere else under search -> BLOCK; only by tests -> tests_level. A name loaded by path (a CLI entry, an HTML page) goes in entry

explain.what: The branch adds an export that no other file uses.
explain.why: An export promises that other code needs this name. An unused one is dead code that every reader must still check, and it often means a change was left half done.
explain.fix: Use it, or remove the export keyword (or the whole name). If only tests use it, test it through the code that does. If a CLI or an HTML page loads it by path, add it to the rule's entry list.

head.engine/lib/a.mjs:
export const a = 1;
export const lonely = () => 2;

head.engine/lib/m.mjs:
export const seed = 2;
export const grow = n => n * seed;
